CustomField.description: When true, the formTemplate runtime suppresses the post-submission confirmation / wrap-up page even if a Confirmation Page Message exists. Use this when the Flow handles its own post-submit navigation or redirect instead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to skip the thank-you / confirmation screen after submission, for example when your Flow redirects users somewhere else. Leave unchecked to show the confirmation message.
CustomField.label: Skip Confirmation Page
